## Personality

Fred Wright is known for his nice and jolly disposition. However, he has since developed a cantankerous demeanor.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P14](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0014), [v4 CHAPTER 11 THE STORY OF LESLIE MOORE P0](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0000)_

## History

Fred Wright owned a fine farm and was considered a model young man. Shortly before [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) departed for college, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovered him and [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) together in the garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confided to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that she and Fred were engaged. Fred later married [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) in a ceremony at her family's home.

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P6](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P7](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0007), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P9](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0009), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P12](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0012), +17 more_

## Relationships

### [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--fred-wright.md)

Fred is romantically involved with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), and the two are engaged to be married. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discovers them spending time together in the garden, after which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) confides the news of their engagement to her.

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P6](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0006), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), +24 more_
